Image 2 is the exact coordinate/edge reference. This is a native hand-painted Taoist chibi game map crop. In image 1 the diagonal ivory coping and gray wall are about 180 px too low where they enter the left edge. Use image 2's sharp left 115 px strip as immutable anchor: the coping upper edge enters x=0,y≈480 and crosses x=115,y≈418; the coping LOWER edge enters x=0,y≈660 and crosses x=115,y≈596; the gray wall bottom enters x=0,y≈765 and crosses x=115,y≈701. Continue these three straight diagonal edges toward the upper right behind the capped post, with exactly this width, pitch and height. Do NOT keep the incorrect image 1 left-edge positions y≈660/810/940. Keep image 2's top 115 px paving anchor and preserve its grout positions. The post stays near x=730, the red rail stays lower-right. Keep the original warm gray stone / ivory coping / light tan pointed post cap; use soft refined hand painted shading and round edges, avoiding gritty realism. Rebuild paving in the area exposed by the moved coping with matching angled stone joints and natural continuous shading. Single uninterrupted geometry: no break or step where x=115 crosses any coping or grout edge. No added objects, text, characters, foliage, UI, borders. Native 1254×1254 opaque PNG, no resize or softened rendering.
